body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1.

surges.html: The target also resists 1 unit of forced movement from that Action.
Suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.
